override._why: Start/A from 10.5 s loop on NEW PROFILE: A on Name opens the name keyboard, Start confirms it, so the keyboard is on screen in every screenshot (looked like the game ignored A and Start, #141/#142). Without the default presses the attract demo plays; Start, then A opens NEW PROFILE, Down Down A creates the profile, A picks Campaign, the level and the briefing's Start. The menus fade slowly, so presses are 4 s apart.
